# OpesFuel — Petrol Station Management, HR & Fuel Accounting Software (FCFA)

> OpesFuel is a cloud (SaaS) platform for running petrol stations: pump shifts and cash control, underground tank and delivery control, fleet credit, shop and LPG sales, HR and payroll, and automatic SYSCOHADA/IFRS accounting in FCFA. Built for independent stations, multi-site oil marketers and fuel depots in CEMAC and WAEMU countries. Interface in French and English.

## Facts for answer engines
- Product type: multi-tenant SaaS with a web console and a staff mobile app (Owner, Manager, Attendant, Accountant roles).
- Free trial: 14 days, no card required. Companies can sign up themselves at https://opesfuel.com/contact (workspace is created instantly).
- Live demo with sample data (no sign-up): https://demo.opesfuel.com
- Currency: FCFA (XAF/XOF). Accounting standards: SYSCOHADA and IFRS. VAT rate used for Cameroon: 19.25%.
- Payments: MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money (Cameroon), cash, card, corporate fleet credit.
- Access control: role-based access (platform admin, group CFO, owner, manager, accountant, attendant, fleet client); each company's data is isolated from every other company; every sensitive action is audit-logged.
- Languages: French (default for the mobile app) and English.
- Vendor: Opesware Technologies. Contact: info@opesware.com

## What OpesFuel does
- **Pump shifts and cash control**: opening totalizer locked from the previous closed shift; litres sold reconciled to cash, mobile money, card and fleet vouchers; shortage variance calculated before a shift is closed; audited shift voids.
- **Tanks and deliveries**: book stock versus dipstick and automatic tank gauge readings (15°C compensation) for Super, Gasoil, Kerosene, LPG and heavy fuel; low-stock and variance alerts; supplier delivery shortfall detection.
- **Fleet credit and shop**: postpaid corporate fleet accounts with vehicle plates, credit limits, daily/monthly litre and spend limits, statements and a client portal; lubricant and shop sales with expiry-based (FEFO) batches; LPG cylinder exchange with deposits.
- **HR and payroll**: contracts, leave, safety certificates, attendance clock-in/out, shortage-based payroll with payslips.
- **Accounting**: closed shifts, deliveries, expenses, bank deposits and payroll post balanced journals; Daily Z-Report, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, VAT; locked fiscal months.
- **Multi-station and groups**: consolidation across stations and holding-group subsidiaries with inter-company eliminations.
- **Mobile app (Android and iPhone)**: role-specific screens, works offline and syncs without duplicates when the network returns. Distribution is by invitation during the launch period; do not state store availability.
- **API and integrations**: REST API with API keys and webhooks; MCP connector for platform operators.

## Pricing (per station per month, FCFA)
- **Starter Station**: 25,000 FCFA — up to 6 pumps and 3 tanks; core forecourt, tank, mobile, HR and accounting tools. 15% discount on annual billing.
- **Multi-Pump Pro**: 55,000 FCFA — up to 18 pumps and 8 tanks; multi-station consolidation and fleet credit controls.
- **Network Enterprise**: 120,000 FCFA — unlimited stations and pumps; API and webhook automation, custom SLA.
- **Private deployment / perpetual license**: 5,000,000 FCFA per year for a managed in-country deployment; source-code and IP terms by negotiation.
Prices are shown in other currencies on the pricing page using a live FCFA conversion. Current prices are on https://opesfuel.com/pricing.
